author: bunniesandmilktea
body:
Irrawaddy Taste of Burma in Stanton - only place in OC that serves Burmese food.

Habuya Okinawan Dining in Tustin - serves Okinawan cuisine. Like the former, this is the only place in all ot OC that serves Okinawan food.

author: Adventurous-Safe-760
body: Not Los Angeles, but there’s also a Burmese spot in Covina, called Mandalay Morning Star & their food is SOOOOO good! I was recommended it by a Burmese friend & it did not disappoint. Highly recommend their duck egg curry (or river prawn curry) & their tea leaf salad!
